purpose: Preserve the frozen Stage70 pair-redundancy objective while replacing penalty-expanded cardinality and quality constraints with explicit CQM constraints, then test whether the resulting objective is robust to matched and stress coefficient noise.

constraint_native_model.objective_rule: Minimize the frozen Stage70 stable pair redundancy without penalty terms.
constraint_native_model.pair_center_rule: Subtract c=(minimum pair coefficient + maximum pair coefficient)/2 from every pair coefficient and add c*choose(k,2) to the constant; this preserves all fixed-k objective energies exactly.
constraint_native_model.normalization_rule: Divide centered objective coefficients and the constant by the maximum absolute centered pair coefficient. Explicit constraints are not folded into objective coefficients.

noise_screen.quantization_rule: Round each normalized centered objective coefficient independently to the nearest multiple of the stated full-scale step; the constant and explicit constraints are not perturbed.
noise_screen.gaussian_rule: Add independent zero-mean Gaussian noise with the stated sigma to every normalized centered objective coefficient; the constant and explicit constraints are not perturbed.
noise_screen.interpretation: All levels are dimensionless project sensitivity probes relative to normalized objective full scale. They are not specifications for any physical QPU or hybrid service.

formulation_gate.interpretation: The matched and stress levels are frozen project decision rules. A pass authorizes only a later solver-scaling benchmark, not direct QPU execution or a quantum-advantage claim.

interpretation_boundary: Stage72 is a post-hoc logical-formulation study on four consumed historical targets. It tests exact objective preservation, feasible-state topology, and software coefficient sensitivity with explicit constraints. It does not test a physical embedding, a hardware sampler, hybrid-service scaling, independent target efficacy, wall-clock speedup, or quantum advantage.
